faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before your first call.

q1.question: How do I get started?
q1.answer: You sign up, tell us your hours and services, and forward your existing line to OrderAI. Most shops are live in about 10 minutes — no installs, no new hardware.

q2.question: Do I need a new phone number?
q2.answer: No. You keep your current number. Calls forward to OrderAI when you're busy or closed, so customers never notice a difference.

q3.question: What if the AI doesn't understand a customer?
q3.answer: It asks a clarifying question, just like a good receptionist. If it still can't help, it warm-transfers to your staff or takes a clear message and texts you a summary.

q4.question: Which languages does it support?
q4.answer: English, Spanish, Mandarin, and Vietnamese. It detects the caller's language and responds naturally in it.

q5.question: Does it connect to my booking or POS system?
q5.answer: Yes. Growth and Pro plans sync bookings and customer details with Square, Toast, and Mindbody so your calendar stays accurate.

q6.question: Is my customer data secure?
q6.answer: Call data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and is only used to handle your calls. We never sell customer data.

q7.question: How long does setup take?
q7.answer: Around 10 minutes for a single location. We walk you through forwarding and confirm a test call before you go live.

q8.question: What's the cancellation policy?
q8.answer: Month-to-month, cancel anytime from your dashboard. No long-term contract and no cancellation fee.
